about: Modes of the Figma `velo` collection (FE-234 item 6, owner's decision 23.11.2026; docs/figma-protocol.md §8.4). The first mode is the core: the neutral values of frontend/tokens.json. Every other mode is a skin: tokens.json plus the overrides of the skin package of its `brand`, pinned by tag and commit in .github/brand-skins.json (the one pin file: CI builds and shoots the same packages). Nobody edits a mode by hand: scripts/sync-figma-variables.mjs --skin computes the values, docs/figma/front/modes-lib.figma.js writes them. figmaModeId pins a mode that already exists in Figma (gold = the former Default, 3905:0: kit swatches and the Skin / gold section are set to it). Figma Professional allows 4 modes per collection. coreOnlyCollections have one mode and get the core values (a skin that overrides one of their tokens is reported, not stored).
